newsitem.title: LATVIA: RADIO EARLY AFTERNOON HEADLINES - APRIL 23.
newsitem.headline: RADIO EARLY AFTERNOON HEADLINES - APRIL 23.

text.p: These are the headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia at noon on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- President Guntis Ulmanis is currently in talks with the representatives of the three major political parties, Democratic Party Saimnieks, Latvia's Way and Fatherland & Freedom. No further details were released by the president's office.
- A Western non-governmental organisation has agreed to pay a one million lats bail for Aleksander Lavent, former head of failed Banka Baltija.
- Rigas Siltums heating company has warned the Opera house, which has failed to pay some 4,500 lats bill, that it will be cut off.
